prefab.name: Project Zomboid
prefab.description: Official Project Zomboid dedicated server (Build 42), installed and updated with SteamCMD.

open.label: Open
open.help: Off: only existing accounts (allow list) can join.

save_minutes.label: World save (minutes)
save_minutes.help: 0: on shutdown and at the game's own pace.

admin_password.label: Admin account password
admin_password.help: Account “admin”, created on the first start.

server-ini.description: Server configuration. Keys managed by the settings are rewritten at start; the server rewrites the file on shutdown.

sandbox.description: World settings (zombies, loot, seasons…). Edit while the server is stopped.

mod_ids.label: Mods to enable
mod_ids.help: A Workshop item can hold several mods (variants, options): the server downloads the item, then only enables the mods listed here. One identifier per line, as the author gives it (often “Mod ID: …” in the description).
